Take the money and run? I hope not; my fingers are crossed that the game gets fixed. I will update my review if things change. *** UPDATE*** The game was patched! Finally! Yes! It no longer freezes when you try and join games online. Well, it doesn't freeze every few seconds on the Crime.net screen anymore. It still freezes when you select a job and try to join a game, and it still won't let you join any games. I added a star for effort to my rating.

title: It feels nice in my hands and I can hold the 3ds ...
text: It fits very loose on my New 3ds XL. You also can't swap out carts without removing it. It feels nice in my hands and I can hold the 3ds better with it. I'd say it's a toss up between having a better grip on your 3ds or not having the flexibility of switching games easily. It should have been designed better, but because I usually only play one game at a time and swap it out once I finish it, I may just continue to use it. Also, it doesn't seem to mark up my 3ds when I take it off. I have a nice looking one and if it scratched it at all I would have rated it much lower. edit: After more use it seems that it likes to make it's way off the 3ds when I carry it around in my bag. This worries me as I don't want my 3ds scratched up. Of course, when I try and take it off myself it doesn't ever want to and I have to work for it. Perhaps there is some simple way to do it and I am missing it. I am never able to hit the power button with this on my 3ds, I have to use the stylus and that just means it will get worn out faster. Because of these things I am taking off one star.

title: This game was wicked fun, especially with 2 players.
text: It's less a game and more of an interactive movie, you can't really lose but you can change how the story goes. The graphics are great, the gameplay is fun and the sound is very good. When I got the game, I popped it in to the PS3 and after an update was at the main menu. I went through the options and stuff, and found out there could be two players. My daughter quickly grabbed a controller and decided to play as the "spirit". I played as the main character, doing things like walking around and beating people up. She played as the ghost or "spirit" Aiden(?) and could move stuff and do other supernatural things. Basically you switch between the two characters to get things done, CIA spy stuff or teen "Carrie" stuff, or even saving homeless people stuff. She got really mad when I wouldn't do what she wanted me to do, but I told her I play like I want and she plays like she wants. As Aiden she can be mean and vengeful or helpful and peaceful. Once we finish the game we will have to switch parts, I want to try being a ghost and totally poltergeist that party of rowdy teens! If there was more gameplay and less interactive movie, I would have given 5 stars. It's major funage, and even better with a friend (or relative). It's mostly like Heavy Rain; press a direction or hit a button fast. Sometimes I didn't know which direction to press in a fight, it was confusing a little, but I couldn't "die" so it was all good (after some practice I got better, but the fight sequences could have been a little more clear). So if you are looking for a good story (told out of sequence, yeah for nonlinear) and like interactive movies, this is the game for you. And it's cheap. And buy "Heavy Rain" too! It's also wicked fun, more so with the PS3 Move.

title: Review of a card? CrAzY!
text: So, it's 12+1 months of XBox Live. You play online? You need this. Good price, but less than a day after I bought it from Amazon I found it for $10 less. Too bad. Hadn't even shipped but Amazon wouldn't let me cancel it, even though I had ordered it on Sunday 5am and tried to cancel it on Sunday at 7pm. Still, this a product review not a store review. The product is great. Worked great. Love the extra month included. Much MUCH cheaper than paying monthy through XBL, and a better deal than buying a whole year on XBL as well.

title: Great game, great price
text: $30 is all I paid and it was worth evry penny. Portal is a fun 1st person puzzle game. It's the reason I bought Orange Box. Team Fortress 2 is such an improvment on the 1st one! It's incredible fun. I'm not much in to Half Life 2 single player, but Ep 1 and Ep 2 do add more content to the wonderful Half Life 2 game. I already had Hald Life 2, so I was able to give the extra copy to a friend so they can enjoy the game as well! I really liked that, as I didn't want to waste money on a game I already had. I don't see any reason not to buy Orange Box. You even get Peggle Extreme which is a HL themed (demo) version of Peggle. I liked it so much that I bought Peggle Deluxe from STEAM.

title: Pinging echo noise (update 2022)
text: I like it, but if I have to be critical: There's a pinging echo noise, like a metallic vibration when releasing the keys on each stroke. Also, yes they provide orings to make the keys a little more silent, but the oring partially blocks the light that comes from the LED, giving each letter on the keyboard a gradient of light instead of solid. You can also see the color of the oring through the translucent letters. Update April 2022: Definitely I regret buying this keyboard. It's very hard to get used to it. I can't really type fast well. I went back to my old cheap logitech.

title: Great System
text: The 3DS is pretty good i do give it a 5 out of 5. it great for deployment reason any time your traveling it makes it go faster. i agree the graphics could be better for 2011 but graphics dont make a game. It really fun with its mini game i enjoy shoot the face of my boss. the camera is pretty good during the day at night you need some lights. great battery life i play this the thing every chance i get and when ever i am plan a game and need to stop i just close it put it on the charger and when i get back start back exactly where i left off.

title: The 90s are missed.
text: I’ve been looking forward to this release since I first heard about it, I flew to Amazon to preorder the T. rex edition (I’m a fan, and a collector of physical media with games) I have the original Joe and max and it’s sequel on snes with cartridges and box, I even got the limited edition re-release when it came out! So trust me when I say, I love the series. HOW DID THEY MESS THIS FORMULA UP SO BAD?!?! We live in times where the properties from back in the day are getting sequels or remakes and they’re coming out in top shape! Streets of rage 4, Battletoads, TMNT…and so forth. The devs of this game completely missed the mark on what made the originals so good, First off for you to start and have 30 enemies on screen not letting you get past the first screen without dying a few times is a TERRIBLE first impression and unfortunately it doesn’t get better from there. The graphics are the selling point of the game, They’re definetly nice to look at, Other than that though it’s just poorly done. The game has no soul, The hit detection is off, The weapons have barely any impact, Too much going on at 1 time to even appreciate the art in the game, I honestly jumped back on the originals to see if I just remembered incorrectly, I beat the original game with only 2 lives lost. It took me 3 continues to beat this first stage, They really need to balance out the difficulty and the overall layout, It went from platforming fun to just frantic “where the heck am I on the screen” type of gameplay. It hurts to say that this is a hard pass until it (Hopefully) gets patched and updated, hard pass. 2.0/10

title: Z for Zorro
text: Honestly, know what you’re getting. I actually recieved this game accidentally. I had no idea it was based on an existing TV show, I had put it as a preorder thinking it was one thing and forgot to cancel! But I’m so glad I didn’t. It’s a super charming game. I’m 37 years old so I’m definetly not the target audience for this, it was more for the kids but I decided I’ll try it out and more than likely return it since I’m the only one that cares for the big Z here, But let me tell you…it’s AWESOME. It’s not a simple game, I actually think kids will have a hard time with this one. The graphics are nothing crazy but they look really nice for the asthetic its attemption to give which is the Saturday morning cartoon vibe. You have a stage and certain missions to complete in whichever order you choose, You can do the missions stealth wise by attacking enemies through rooftops, Light poles, In the shadows, You also get enough of These and you build up your power meter which gives you an attack that gets rid of the enemy in one hit! There’s 18 stages in all and each stage aside from the first one take about 30-40 minutes to complete! So do the math, it’s outstanding amount of gameplay! The reason I don’t give it a perfect score is because the audio department, While serviceable is lacking, But honestly if you’re a fan of sorrows, Want a game that resembles something from the ps2 era, Done completely right, Then look no further! It’s a budget game and a complete surprise for me, Still haven’t passed it For the kids to play…It’s quite the addictive gameplay loop here! You can wait until it’s on sale but honestly it’s worth the $40 asking price. $30 would be the sweet spot though! 8.5/10 Don’t sleep on this one.

title: Streets of rage 2…The sequel
text: If you enjoy streets of rage 2 Specifically (This has similar music, similar power ups, health pickups, weapons and boss structure) Then THIS is the game you’ve been waiting for. Beautiful 16 but era graphics with an AMAZING soundtrack. Remember that these beat ‘em ups were quick plays so it’s over after 6 stages, BUT there are challenges to beat and tons of unlockables! Well designed character models, Controls are fluid, Graphics made me feel like I’m playing a brand new Genesis game without the Genesis sounds (Thank baby Jesus) all in all, This is a sleeper hit of a game you don’t want to miss. For what it is: A retro, Streets of rage 2 inspired, Side scrolling beat ‘em up with beautiful graphics and music along with sounds, Nice stage layout, great variety, I must say this is the rare 10/10. (This perfect score is based on the game it is, for example I wouldn’t put it on the same level as xenoblade 3 by any means, But for a retro inspired beat em up, It’s perfection)

title: Wompa Wompa World
text: Do you miss playing platformers of the N64/GameCube era? Are you a fan of Mario or crash bandicoot games? Do you wish more games were like Banjo Kazooie or Donkey Kong 64? Have you played the original and miss it? If you answered yes to any of the questions above then by all means, This warrants a purchase. A perfect price for the platformer genre to have nice sales numbers. Great graphics, And if by some reason you don’t own the original Pac-Man in 5 million other compilations that’s included here as well as new mazes that are modernized when the game is completed. Great sound, Great graphics, Fun old school gameplay, Easy to understand and jump on! You can have a blast by yourself or telling your family members where to jump or grab an item they missed! The only thing I have to knock off for points is that I wish it was a bit longer, The sound is good but there’s not much to it, Those are honestly just nitpicks if I had to give a negative but honestly, This deserves your time. This is not another Run of the mill remaster that’s been coming out lately it’s one developed with love and attention to detail! 4/5

title: Capcom presents…
text: HADOUKEN! Alright, Alright so if you’re on this page you know what this is! You’re either a retro gamer, A collector, Or someone whose experiencing these titles for the first time (I wish I was) it’s a VERY nice collection with tons and tons of Museum pieces to learn about the history of each game. The presentation is crystal clear and you can literally customize it to your complete liking! Then why not a perfect 5 stars? Well…. There’s no new ground here. Aside from the unreleased darkstalkers title, Most have played these games in various other collections, But what baffles me the most is that this came out 2 weeks apart from capcom Arcade collection 2, Which included most of the games listed on here already! I feel like it was a bit of a cash grab to do that to the fans. I love old school capcom (You can only like current time capcom if you enjoy resident evil or Monster hunter since that’s all they seem to put their efforts on to these days) It’s an amazing little collection, Is it worth $40? A little hard to say. If you don’t love retro gaming or are new to the genre in general this would exactly be the best place to start. The games are unforgiving in difficulty, Although you can change the settings technically but my kids tried at the lowest difficulty and failed. I can rock it with the difficulty almost all the way up so it’s honestly just a matter of patience and learning curves, Which you will get! But if you want a quick fix, Try Capcom arcade 2 on the digital storefronts. If you want some Hadoukens, Yoga fires, Vampiric and (oddly enough) Cyber mecha fighting, Then look no further! Beautiful graphics that can be smoother out in options or even made to look like the days of the arcade! Great selection of games (Although a bit lacking on it being different properties rather than SF, Darkstalkers, etc) The sound is top notch and everutging can be customized to your liking! All in all this is a very well rated 8.5/10!

title: Lights out…
text: I got this game on sale for $10. Didn’t know much about it but I collect games for the switch and added this one, But this one I was curious enough to try it out, And…While it looks like a game that was made specifications for VR, it’s a game that plays just ok on the switch. You figure out a few logic puzzles that stop you getting from point A to point B, Put out a few fires, Explore the level for Nooks and Cranny. It plays ok, A little slow on the controller, The lag is minimal but it’s there, Also the player (Or the hands in this case) Doesn’t control well, Other than that there’s nothing wrong with the game itself it’s just wildly un entertaining after a few go’s with it. Granted I’m not the target age range for this but if You’re looking for an offbeat game, Always dreamt of putting out fires or want to see what a VR game looks like on a console then by all means grab a copy (On sale) But if you’re strapped for cash and this is the one you’re thinking of picking over others, Don’t. There’s much better options out there 5/10.

title: XenoWow!
text: I’m not a xenoblade fanboy, Got the original, Didn’t care for it…Got chronicles X on Wii U and didn’t care for it either, Skipped part 2 because I thought it was an overhyped game that was just barren/empty wastelands, But my friend convinced me with all the footage he saw and leaks and so forth, And I was like I’ll give them one more shot, 2 days later as I write this review I’m 16 hours in, And I’m confident enough to write a review, Give it a perfect score of 5 stars, And tell you that this game is a MUST OWN title for EVERY RPG fan. The graphics are nice, But that isn’t the main draw of the title, We all know the switch is dated hardware, But the gameplay is PHENOMENAL. The story, To the point where I am at least has been absolutely engaging. It knows how to hook you in and develop in a way that you want to know what’s next. So many different areas to explore and secrets to uncover, Crafting, Cooking, Class switching, Gem creating, Character Merging, Honestly I can go on and on, I’ve never on Amazon left a perfect review for a game, But in all honesty I don’t have to play it all the way through to know that there’s no way this game will go downhill the further along you get, It starts in the midst of action. You don’t need to play previous Xenoblade titles as it’s its own beast. If you have played the previous titles it does have certain nods to it and story elements that tie it in, But think of it as final fantasy, It’s just a numbered entry in the universe of Xeno but it’s not a sequel. If you’re on the fence on getting it, I was as well…I understand all too well how you feel but do yourself a favor and pick this one up, It’s a strong contender for the best switch game I’ve played which was previously held by Breath of the wild…This game is a 10/10. Masterpiece. Thank me later and enjoy 😃

title: Serious Sword Skills.
text: If you don’t know about Samurai Showdown series from the SNK arcade and home console days there 5 million ways to play them on every console/emulator known to man from 93 on. This game is fantastic, So good in fact I had it on ps4 and when I upgraded to the series X I got it again for the extra characters and the HUGE reduction in load times. The graphics take a bit to get used to, It’s a modern rendition on cel-shaded graphics from the ps2 era. The moves are fantastic in this game, However they did simplify the control scheme for players who are new to the series, I’m not one to complain as the more players there are the more chance there is for the series to keep moving along. Great sounds from the game, Incredible move set, Nice character selection, Detailed levels, Although in this day and age I do expect a deeper story mode and that’s where my negatives come in, With as much more and as much experience as this title has under its belt it’s about time they give it the Story mode treatment that’s not just a beginning text, A middle standard cutscene that’s the same for everyone, And an ending unique to each character which is blink and you’ll miss it. I do love the series, And I hope this is the reset button to make a fresh new start to make it much bigger and better on the next one, If you’re new to the series start here! And if you’re not and you’ve been waiting for a price reduction, Now is the time! All in all a strong 8.8/10. Based on price at the current time, Graphics and sound. Story is lacking and therefore it recieved a reduction in score as well as a few ticks off for other bugs encountered during gameplay.

title: *Snap Snap*
text: It’s hard to write a review for a simple game like this, I’m an 80’s baby and have a huge collection of games, So I’ve played all kinds of games, Seen innovation, Watched them for from sides scrollers to platformers to Vr and right back to 8-bit. The point I’m getting to is that out of those games there are very few where I can sit and play with my wife and kids and just everyone have a great time and point out where they see secret items or which character is best to take out the most difficult enemy, If you’re going to go at it alone, I wouldn’t reccomend it only because it’s meant to be played with someone else. It’s simple, You have infinite continues, There’s checkpoints everywhere, The graphics are sub-par, No adams family theme song anywhere in the game, HOWEVER this one got me. It’s been ridiculously fun to discover secret areas, Fall off the most absurd cliffs, Play the minigames in between the levels (There are plenty which is cool) And to be honest that’s not a feeling that most games give me. I can’t rate it higher than a certain threshold because if not ID be comparing it with the greats since Amazon doesn’t have at the very least a 10 point grading scale even if it only goes to 5 so it doesn’t have to be whole numbers. The game is fast, It’s funny, It’s innocent, It’s forgiving, It’s friendly, And purely innocent…But it’s A LOT of fun, it’s about 8 hours long, Nothing your child can’t see here, No force fed story or agenda, The story is just kind of there, But trust me if you’re looking for one to play with your kids or partner and don’t want to break the bank I highly suggest you check this one out! All in all for what it is I give it a 7/10 based on price, gameplay, and fun factor. Check it out!

title: Miami Vice life
text: This game is so fun, and frustratingly difficult, But once you figure out the best way to enter a room and get everyone without getting hurt yourself it’s a huge satisfactory feeling. Simplistic graphics are part of the retro charm, The appeal here is the gameplay and the strategy. The collectors edition brings some nice stuff along with it, I love the cover and I’m a collector so I had to own the physical edition. All in all it’s one you have to play yourself to see what it’s like. Cool music, Cool story, Funny, Witty and overall a cult classic. Don’t sleep on this one! 7.5/10 Check this one out

title: GatorDone
text: This game is quite funny, You’re an alligator walking around and eating everything in sight until you level up and can eat bigger stuff and so forth, It’s a novelty game that’s fun for half an hour to laugh with and a few beers, And then you put it on the shelf until your buddy reminds you it exists years later. I paid $8 for it on sale, And I still feel I overplayed. It’s funny, But it’s not good. The controls are a nightmare, Just to get this animal to walk where you want it to walk at any sort of speed is disastrous. It’s “open world” in a very small way. You can only access areas based on your level, because if you’re underpowered you will die. If you go into the wrong river you will die, If you stay out hunting too late you will die. Get used to dying again, and again. The graphics are ok I guess, I mean who plays this for the beauty of it? It’s an idea thrown by a couple of new devs to sell copies to kids and adults who are into crocodiles or to players who thought they’d get some sort of animal like experience through the title. It’s simplistic in nature but the controls make it a lot more challenging than it has to be. Not much else to say about this title, it’s a 3.5/10 due to the humor factor stated above, But once that novelty wears off you’re left with a shallow, boring, repetitive, ugly game that you’ll probably never play again, you can safely skip this one. Save your time

title: Rico-less.
text: The original Rico game is one I purchased on sale on the switch and knew nothing about. It was about $10 a few years back and to my surprise I had a complete blast with the game! It wasn’t perfect by any stretch of the imagination but it was an Indy Roguelite Fps game done with love and a limited budget, So when I saw a sequel was coming out I had to get it! Oh boy.. I’ll start with the positives: This is leagues above the original with the targeting and shooting elements, And the cel shaded graphics don’t look bad at all! Unfortunately that’s where the compliments end. All 2 of em. The first RICO as I wrote above had innovation, Even in its crudeness and low budget, It had a campaign and as you were doing your campaign it would randomize missions such as rescue the hostage, Get files, Clear the floor, Breach the doors, Etc…This game tosses every one of those Elements out the window in favor of a completely streamlined experience. You have hostages maybe twice during the “campaign”. I say campaign in quotation marks because the story is as generic and throwaway as they come, You start off by breaching the doorway in front of you (There is barely any room that has more than one door available to breach, So 2 players playing co op and breaching from 2 different sides has as well been tossed out minus VERY few occasions) you get the slow-mo time to shoot, You get them all and you can now pick up their weapons. You have throwing knives as well which 1 shots the enemy, You go to the next room and clear it after breaching the doorway. I hope you REALLY ENJOY breaching endless rooms because this is literally ALL you do for the incredible 1 hour and 48 minutes it took me to beat the story mode. Yes, a whole almost 2 hours. The levels feel stretched, So stretched in fact I was wondering if the game glitched and I’m just going into the exact same rooms I was in previously over, and over and over again (This is all true, I was about to restart the game until I realized a different color door in front of me and the level finally ended) After those extremely repetitive, boring and just plain bad 2 hours I was like well let’s see what I unlocked…You get nothing, the ONLY OTHER MODE is a daily mission, Which mind you is set in the same exact locations as the story mode. No variety or thought was put into this title at all. It’s so basic, so boring and repetitive I’m still in disbelief. It’s incredibly buggy as well, There’s barely a game here and somehow before you reach the next room the frame rate drops so incredibly low that the music skips and you stutter while walking, and there is no one but you in that room. The music is repetitive, 3 house tracks that loop every 50 seconds or so, I hope you love the beats or the mute button shall be used, It drove my wife crazy. Terrible story mode, Repetitive mission structure, No variety, Re skinned versions of the same weapons you use throughout the entire game, No rogueLike elemtents at all, No other places to go aside from the same building, No branching pathways like the original, It’s baffling that this is what they chose to put out. This could’ve been great as a DLC to the first game to just add more content, But this is NOT worth $40, $30 or even sadly $20. This is a $10-15 super budget title that will be in bargain bins for the forseable future. Save your time and money, And skip this one, This one game is going to put this franchise on a complete halt unless someone comes in and gives the fans of the original game what they want. This isn’t even worth a rental, It’s a 1.5/10. SKIP AND AVOID.

title: Oh man…
text: So I didn’t expect a massive rpg, Nor any action, TBH my expectations were pretty low for this game…And this is coming from someone who liked both visual novels and loves the original bloodlines game, HOWEVER… This game is a huge buggy mess, peoples faces have just straight up dissapeared when I’ve spoken to them, Pop in texture is horrifying, I haven’t seen. It this bad in a game in years, And this is the series X version we’re speaking of here. The graphics look like the characters were dipped in grease and have the most dead looking faces I’ve ever seen, Nothing in this world feel alive. The gameplay is just as bad, Aside from there being ABSOLUTELY NO ACTION, 0%, None, Nada, Could’ve been forgiven if the game has a strong plot since you know…That’s what would have to hold it down as it has pretty much nothing else to rely on, It is excruciatingly boring. It’s hard to get through the story, Hard to care for the characters, And in a game that gives the illusion of dialogue choices, You pick the answer you like and you guessed it, You get it wrong. So you have to power up some of your abilities to be able to answer these questions, But the game mentions a brief introduction on how to do this in text on a menu and you never see it again. Right when you begin you can’t talk much, So why are the options even available? Is it for a second play through? This is the kind of confusing mess you’d be walking into. This game is worth at MAX $15-$20 price range. I support devs, I support indie games, I give things a chance, But save your hard earned money, And your time. It’s bad, Maybe if you catch it on a super sale and if you’re still interested with the knowledge of what I wrote above then hey, Power to you and I hope you enjoy it, But in all honesty…This is the worst next gen game I’ve played, And one of the worst full priced releases I’ve ever touched. Well its $10 less or $20 less depending o the generation you own. Glitchy, Buggy, greasy, Dead eyed graphics, HORRIBLE sound that’s uneven in my surround sound and on the stereo in my television, Terrible tutorials (Pretty much none after an initial text on screen) Terrible story, Cringe worthy voice acting and no gameplay minus “investigating” which means walk up to something..Press A or X depending on the console, and follow a trail, enter a room, press A again. This game is a full on stinker. 1.5/10

title: Horiwho?
text: This was a pleasant surprise of a game, I honestly preordered because it’s a Shmup that reminds me of the visuals similar to cotton, Deceptively cute but steep learning curve and difficult, And this one does NOT disappoint in that area. You will die if you hit anything in the stage, You will die if you chill at the edge of the screen because enemies come from both sides, You will die again and again and yet again, Good news is you can study the stage and the best part which are the monstrous bosses. They have a pattern to them it’s all about timing and precision. Know what you’re getting! It looks, feels and plays like a Super Nintendo game. The plot is overly complicated for being a dog and a cat on a plane but the cool twist here is that the gems that you get from the stages help you rebuild destroyed towns which in turn you open up shops to better customize your airplane and bring down the difficulty. You CAN choose fígaro if you want the game to be on easy by default but you lose out on some of the stages as it’s not the full experience. The sounds are nice for what it is, The graphics are simplistic but nice, The plot is complicated, For some reason…But you won’t play this for the plot. I think it’s worth the $30 price tag. This is one of those games that don’t get a bunch of copies printed out and becomes rare in the long run, But honestly I’ve really enjoyed my time with it and if you’re a fan of the genre and find beauty in simplicity…You will as well. I rate games based on what they are. For a cartoon Shmup with mascot characters that’s going for the SNES feel and look, The boss fights, The stages, The rebuilding the town it’s an easy 7.5/10

title: Play like it’s 1997.
text: This game in all honesty is a game made from simpler times in an arcade machine. On rails shooter (You can’t freely move for those that don’t understand the lingo) That you button mash and find weak points on the zombies, Fight a boss, Fight a super zombie, Fught a super boss. Wash, Rinse and repeat. Aside from the simplistic nature, It’s fun as all hell. I love playing through the campaign to get better scores and branch out to different paths. The remake graphics aren’t mindblowing in the least bit, But they are nice. I am hoping for the sequel they add a bit meatier content, I love that they were faithful to the original but these games don’t need a faithful recreation, But to have been inspired by it and expand on the basic lore from these stories into something a little bit more…2022 perhaps. The music is your basic rock riffs, The sounds are nice and the features are actually pretty cool! Owning the physical edition is phenomenal, I love the Limidead cover art with the 3D card and the cardboard cutouts included inside, Great package, Wait for a sale if you’re unsure..it’s super short, About 45 minutes to be exact but it has a ton of replay value, So grab a friend or your partner and travel back to a simpler time. 7.5/10

title: Where’d the rest of my game go?
text: I’m a HUGEEEE Mario fan. Super Mario bros on NES was the first game I ever played in my life, I was 3 yrs old in 1988 and it came bundled with my Nintendo, I get EVERYTHING MARIO, I mention this so you don’t think I’m just hating on this just to hate, Quite the opposite, It hurts that I’m writing this review m, But if I can help someone save $60 I will, In this economy I know ID appreciate it. I’m not going to go too much into detail here so let me simplify it, It’s a fun game, Really fun in fact..IF there was ANYTHING to do! No story mode for some illogical reason so we get cups, ok fine I was willing to live with that, The cups are ALL THE SAME EXACT THING. Since there’s BARELY any characters to play the game with, All characters you choose you’ll be going up against, I’ve played against the exact same team that I’ve chosen multiple times! This looks like it was made in a few months, Aside from an amazing looking opening introduction FMV, This game falls completely short and is an utter disappointment not only to sport fans but Mario fans. Nintendo has had the trend recently with their sport games to release unfinished titles, Mario golf star rush didn’t have a lot to do but honestly I feel bad that I EVER COMPLAINED with that game. It had a story mode, it had competitions and a competent multiplayer. The multiplayer aspect of the game is an utter letdown, You believe well they didn’t concentrate on single player so Multiplayer must be making up for it somehow, Absolutely not. You would think if everyone had their own switch they can play each character on your team (There’s 4 of them) But no, You can’t. Up to 2 only. And get this, YOU CANT CONTROL THE GOALIE. Ever! One of the biggest points of strategy in sports games is controlling every aspect, And the goalkeeper has to be a dumbed down CPU controlled player. In all honesty I can keep going over how utterly bare bones and disappointing this game is, But..Don’t waste your hard earned money. Times are tough right now, And this game can care less. Shame on the industry for releasing this at $60, But I think we’re the biggest suckers here. 3.5/10. AVOID.

title: Join us in the revolution.
text: Wow, This is a review in progress, I’m 15 hours in and I’m having a complete and total blast with this game. Know what to expect, This is a game made by a handful of people, It’s not your typical AAA assasins creed live game service, It’s more in the vein of the gothic series, If you’re not familiar with that the most closely I can compare it to is Mid 2000s BioWare games: (Knights of the old republic, Jade empire, dragon age) You’re in this huge open world and travel around trying to get people on your side to help with the incoming invasion. The story is A LOT better than I expected it to be, The graphics are ok, I won’t give that one too much credit on the grand scale of things but for such a small team? It’s impressive. The gameplay is fantastic, The game doesn’t hold your hand as much it’s a lot about you discovering locations, looting, Finding secrets, Branches of conversation that dictate the destruction around you (Good and evil plots) But honestly if you miss playing games with big open worlds, Looters, You enjoy the fallout series and have time for a game that’s about 30 hours long then do yourself a favor and check this one out! Thank me later! But remember, Don’t expect AAA. Small team, small budget, BIG ideas. Hope this helps!

title: Pay up with inflation!
text: Didn’t expect this, I bought the 2 taito ps2 games that came out back in that era and they were FILLED with amazing games! It had obscure ones, Newer ones, Japanese only ones. It was so great to have so I expected a similar collection here and boy, Was I utterly disappointed. This is the most bare bones, barely replayable and Uber expensive collection I’ve EVER COME ACROSS. I love collections of old arcade games Such as the Capcom arcade collection, Sega collection, Wonder boy collections and so forth, I’m a sucker for them actually, But THIS? This is what we get for $40? Do yourself a favor and get the ps2/GameCube era collection..Or play the roms because this is an insignificant rip off that’s worth $10. Seriously, over charging here would be $25. $40 for games that are nothing more than a mediocre collection of non memorable 80s games? HARD PASS. I love collections, I am the target fan base for these but this, This is not it. If inflation had an overcharged game in the 2020s, This right here is it. Stay far away. This gets a whole 0.5/10. The half a score is because it exists and the games aren’t terrible but EXTREMELY overpriced.

title: Cotton A la New!
text: Finally, A cotton game that’s not a re-release or a remaster, We get a brand spanking new cotton game…And it’s absolutely fantastic! If you don’t know what cotton is the coined the term Cute Em Up. Which means a side scrolling shmup with cute characters, But don’t let this whole cute thing fool you, I’m a guy, I’m married..And completely into this game. The colors are vibrant and fantastic, It’s fast and furious gameplay, it doesn’t hold your hand but it’s not one that feels impossible. One of those easy to learn, Hard to master titles. Once your done playing there’s still more content after the play through, I won’t spoil it for you here, But in all honesty get it. It’s a toss up if you want to wait for it to go on sale since these games don’t get printed in physical form by the tons and become rare easier than most (Just look for some of the past titles) But great graphics, Nice story, Great action and at $40 you’re getting an at home arcade experience with cute characters that can deff take on a whole lot on the screen at once! An easy 8.5/10! *Must Buy**

title: Classical gaming Bliss
text: So I’m sure if you’re on this page you know what to expect from Wonder boy, Or if you’re in the younger generation and have seen collectors play these games on YouTube or have played the remakes that have come out the past few years, Regardless wonder boy is known in the gaming community for its Platforming/RPG elements and revolutionizing a genre that wasn’t thought of until this title. Let’s start with part 1, It’s an arcade port. Think of it as an endless runner with being able to kill the enemies and platforming that gets gradually more difficult, It’s the weakest in the series but has held up pretty well! Part 2, An arcade port once again but the dynamics that are featured heavily in later monster world titles come from here, This game is the foundation of the game as we know it today so probably the most important one in the series, Be forewarned it is a quarter muncher as it is an arcade title but with an endless rewind feature and save states, You won’t have much trouble getting through it. There are some parts that I’m left wondering how you’re not supposed to spend $10 in quarters to beat it back in the day. As for 3 and 4 there’s a huge shift in quality and gameplay, These are not arcade titles but ports of the Sega console titles, They’ve honestly aged really well! After playing part 2 know what to expect from part 3, But part 4 is my personal favorite! It’s the metroidvania of the series very reminiscent of the Shantae series. This one is legit fun and I highly suggest that you check out the remake that came out not long ago if you like the original! (or you can just get the remake, which includes the original, Decisions decisions). The extras are honestly bare bones, You get an image gallery that looks like it was thrown together in 2 and a half minutes to make it look like the game has more content, Deff one of my least favorite parts of the compilation as it makes it look a little cheap. All in all it’s a nice compilation and worth the $29.99 and if you find it on sale even better! The classics are all here and you can change the aspect to full screen with crisp graphics or it’s original resolution or even throw in a CRT filter to make it look truly old school. It’s a 7/10 for me. I go by the .5 rating system by the way so it’s not a high 7, just an fyi! Try it out if you enjoy classic gaming! Hope this helps

title: Fictional favorites
text: Amazing title for the switch. I’ve owned this on the PC for a while, Had the ps4 copy but then returned it Since I didn’t want to pay for all the dlc. I’ve seen it on the switch store for sale but I don’t have the 16 gigs it requires since it’s all filled up, So when I saw limited run and Amazon partnered up for the physical copy I jumped right into it and I’m so glad I Did! It already includes all the dlc from the previous consoles, Has a story mode that’s more of a visual novel than anything else but the arcade mode is the meat of the game. There’s 3 arcs to play through so you choose your character along with the arc you want to play through, you get their individualized stories and get down to the nitty gritty! The graphics are BEAUTIFUL on the switch, The cover art is fantastic and when you open the case you have instructions on which buttons do what. A manual would’ve completed the set to make it a truly perfect product! Yes there is no English dub but there are subtitles so with some basic English reading skills you’re good to go! Limited run being on Amazon is amazing. Don’t miss out on this title that I guarantee will only get more expensive as time passes by, A 9/10 for me! Check it out! 😀

title: Fantasy tree life
text: So for those that are skeptical I can tell you this much, I’m not much into farming games nor animal crossing (I used to love animal crossing back in the GameCube era) my wife loves all those sim games BUT I preordered this game accidentally a while back and had no idea when it came in what it even truly was about (I’m a collector) but mannnnn, I’ve sunk over 50 hours in the game and still have a ways to go. It’s so different and well made, The story is a bit out there so you’ll see it once you pop it in and play but the gameplay is satisfying, There are no deadlines in which order to do what you can basically tackle and mission in any order. It’s a stress free game with a laid back atmosphere full of magic AND the part that surprised me completely is the Zelda like dungeons! Yes..They’re great little puzzle dungeons. It’s basically find a key and place it somewhere and find another etc etc but it’s very well done. All the places you build out of your imagination with seeds to grow worlds, make your towns the way you like, It’s a bit on the glitchy side of things with frame rate drops but I’ll forgive and forget for the game you’re getting at the price point it is. In all honesty, Buy it. You won’t regret it one but. It’s charming, it’s fun, and you discover more and more to do the more you play. It’s a 5/5 for me.

title: And the winner by knockout…is..
text: Rocky! Knocked out creed 4 times. If you ever wanted Adonis and Apollo creed to go at it, Rocky and Adonis, If you want to hear famous lines like if he dies, He dies. If you want over the top, non simulated boxing that isn’t quite a button masher and actually requires a bit of strategy and isn’t exactly easy even on easy mode, If you like ready 2 rumble, Super punch out, Non serious arcade simulation boxing game then this game is a no brainer. The story mode is based on speech bubbles and short comic strip like stories. The graphics are nice for the arcade feel it’s going for, Every single character has a story line, Some you’ll know from the movie, Others you’ll meet for the very first time and fall under the funniest of stereotypes. But in all honesty this game does what it sets out to do well, Arcade boxing. It’ll hurt your fingers after a few fights from the button pressing and the frustration but it’s a fun fight. The sounds are funny to hear minus Rocky. When you pick Rocky in the story mode every single time his dialogue bubble pops on the screen he does a weird grunt in the most Stallone way possible it’s hilarious. All in all it does what it sets out to do, It’s not done incorrectly, It’s not budget made as most of us are used to. It’s a good quality, Arcade feel, Fantastical boxing game that gets a 4 out of 5 stars. Get it if you miss arcade boxing games, Get it at a lower price if you have no idea what arcade boxers even are 💥🌟

title: What an UTTER disappointment…
text: I’ve played quite a few roguelites (More than 10) and know the concept of them and enjoy them! I know permadeath is one of the trappings and you have to redo again and again while you upgrade your weapons, your health, your skills and try again as you get a bit further each time until you eventually beat it. Hades did this best in my opinion, But anyway. Remember what I said roguelites consist of? This includes NONE of that. You don’t upgrade any weapons or have any coins, Your “permanent” upgrades are the skill of whichever weapon you were lucky enough to find as it’s all randomized and scattered. There is 1 standard attacks and 2 special attacks, But the game is so slow, So choppy and the frame rate is so below standard that I would walk for a few seconds and it would hiccup..IN DOCKED MODE! It closed out on me twice within my first hour of playing. I kept playing to give this game a chance, I read reviews online that stated that it’s meant for more than one player to help, Of course it doesn’t include LOCAL multiplayer so I went online and attempted to join a room…When you do join a room if the host decides to leave the room the game disconnects and you’re back on the main screen with 0 upgrades! It took 17 minutes of me playing for someone to join my room, There are no souls playing this game, I’m starting to think I bought the only copy available through Amazon. The music is bland and repetitive, The graphics are nice in the opening cutscene and the scene when you’re picking your character and their costume, Which every costume has the same ability it’s literally just for asthetics. The English text and grammar is COMPLETELY incorrect. I get it that they’re an independent Japanese developer..But this isn’t the PC, It’s the switch. You should have someone proofread and point out a few things. You only make progress once you defeat the first boss which is 4 levels away, And will be HARD to get to since your upgrades don’t happen unless you’re actively playing. No permanent upgrades, Bland soundtrack, bland visuals, bland characters, bad grammar, choopy frame rate, Stages that look completely alike, No story to speak of, No one online at any time, No reason to want to keep playing. Don’t waste your $30. It’s an embarrassment to video games released physically on consoles. Stay away, Or play it and like my comment after, Dont say I didn’t tell you so. 2/5. It gets a 2 because of the opening cutscene. Sheesh it’s bad.

title: Donkey Kong country fan? Then this is a no brainer..
text: Collecting four letters that even resemble the yellow letter in DKC, Secrets in areas that resemble DKC, Barrels and mine carts were replaced with look alikes, It’s honestly FANTASTIC. Warning though just like the game it pays tribute to it gets fairly difficult fairly quickly as the game is about 4-5 hours long but there’s a casual mode for those who don’t want as much challenge with extra checkpoints and so forth. If you’re a fan of platformers (especially old school ones) This game is not to be missed. It may resemble DKC but it has its own charm and characters and world to explore, 5 stars 🌟

title: Who wants to HEAR a millionaire?
text: *UPDATE ON REVIEW* **They released an update with voices! So now it can be heard with subpar voice acting! Lol. It’s not a bad game at all though and I’m glad they included the voice pack! The original review is below** Fun game! However, You can tell the budget is obviously limited. No voice acting whatsoever, Everything is a ackwardly read with the music in the backround, They could’ve gotten a random joe to read a script but since they want to add more questions in the future I suppose it’s better for their budget. Straightforward so far, You can pick the category of questions. Super simple up until the $32,000 question. There’s an easy mode with no timers set but.. Unless you’re 10, I don’t see much of a point. Not bad for $30, But don’t rush to get this. It’s exactly what you’d expect. Over 3,000 questions though! Graphics are much better than I thought they would be. All in all 6.5/10

title: Phenomenal RHYTHYM game...
text: Lackluster for a kingdom hearts title but amazing if you’re seeking out a rhythm game for the switch. The game is incredibly light on story so if you’re seeking that and only that prepare for disappointment as it gives you a rundown of the first 3 titles and includes 25 minutes of new footage. The characters are fantastic, You level up and gain items which you can use in the harder levels. (Proud difficulty) The game is challenging on Proud mode but not overbearing. With enough practice anyone with enough patience will get it. Don’t listen to the naysayers. It’s a great rhythym title, A not so great kingdom hearts one per se as kingdom hearts has set the bar high to earn that title (minus a few misfires..KH3 DLC Im looking at you) all in all you won’t regret it! Easy 8/10 for this one.

title: Oh so many bugs
text: You'd think after 20+ years they could work out the kinks in basic gameplay. But, no, they don't seem capable of that. if you are looking for a good soccer game, yes, you should buy a recent FIFA. Probably not the latest version since you might pay a premium for a game that's no better than last year's. But, it's sad that they can't do better. Issues: - Offsides is called if, when you pass the ball, your player is even 1mm past the 2nd to last defender. No real ref would call it if that teammate is running back toward you since the small distance isn't an "advantage". And, no real ref would call it if that teammate is completely uninvolved in the play. But, FIFA will call it, since the story seems more important to them than getting the rules right. - You can't call for a low cross. If you have the ball, you press 2x 'X'. If you 2x 'X' when your teammate has the ball on the wing, you'll get a lob, the defense will clear it out of the box, and you'll get dinged for "bad call for pass". - If you call for a pass while your teammate 'A' has the ball and 'A' passes shortly after you call, 'B' will often try to pass to you, even if they're in a horrible position to do so. And, your rating will be dinged as a result. - When I play as forward (I play in career where I only control a single player), I frequently get called for being "out of position" even though there's zero indication on the screen that I'm out of position. I use the camera mode that is half way between my player in the ball. When the ball is near my goal, I can't see my player (except on radar). If the computer has some odd view of my position, I get dinged in the rating. - If I'm center forward and one of my wing teammates is out of position, I get dinged b/c the computer thinks I should swap with the out-of-position player. The out-of-position player doesn't even try to get back in position (even though the ball is far away, near our goal), yet my rating suffers. - The rating does not understand the value of attempting a high risk/reward pass. When I'm playing center forward, I might make as many "bad" passes as my midfielder, but my midfielder's passes are brain dead whereas I'm trying to score a goal. Yet, I get dinged just as much. - The computer doesn't even try to make good passes (I play at the "world class" level). Some passes go directly to the defense. No sane player would make a pass like that. - Many crosses go to the goalkeeper. A lot of crosses are placed in the goalie box (the smaller rectangle). Occasionally this works in real soccer, but, in FIFA, the goalie is extra powerful so these crosses almost never work. Considering how special they make the goalie, the crosses should be going to around the penalty spot. - Throw-ins in '17 were horrible. If I was receiving, they'd go to where I was when I pressed "A" and often go right to the defense. They're better in '18, but still go too often to a contested spot. - Passes from the computer aren't aware of the defense. Real players will look for teammates that are open. Not so in FIFA. Often, I will pass to a teammate because a defender is pressuring me. Often, I'll get a pass right back even though there's a defender on top of me. Hello?!?! - If you started a game with the wrong difficulty, you can't change it and difficulty isn't obvious when you start a game. This is especially a problem w/ my son: I play at world class, but he plays at Amateur or Semi-Pro. Sometimes when he plays alone or when we play together, we start a game at world class w/o realizing it. They should really make this more obvious and/or easier to change. Even with all the warts, I still play. They have all the teams, the game play is overall good, and career mode is nice (though the expectations after 1.5 years become silly).

title: Good idea
text: I wanted to love this but it has a flaw that makes it not do what it is intended to do . It fit perfectly. It did make it possible to go outside and use the vr safely but the tint on it was too dark and prevented the Occulus from being able to track the surroundings. With out the tracking working right it made it hard to play . I’m gonna try using it on a brighter day then I did the first time and will update . Fir now it’s a 4/5 vr accessory. Made well , great idea , just didn’t work out for me on the overcast day I picked to try it out at the park .

title: My vr playing tween approves
text: Extends playing time , well balanced . Kid tested mother approved . My little dude is all about his VR setup . I got him the PS4 vr setup when he was just a little dude and since then he’s gone thru quite a few headsets and graduated to the occulus quest 2 and is a bit of a beast when it comes to gaming. If it’s not made well or right he wont use it or it won’t last long being used . He has an adult sized head for sure , he needs adult sized equipment for a proper fit . The battery pack strap is made well and easily adjusted . Charging cable for everything else vr related is compatible with this . It’s a good upgrade for sure . Nobody wants to quit playing because the battery died , or be stuck plugged in no matter how long the cable is . This solves a lot of issues that limit game play. One of the best extra battery options Iv ordered .

title: Amazing Plug and play adapter
text: It’s an impressive piece of equipment. It does exactly what it advertises and more . Switch ,Steam Deck , Mac , IPhone compatible !! My father in law has an older TV that isn’t a smart TV and he doesn’t have any game if systems to bridge the gap either . My kids know grandpa has an “old Tv “ lol but he does have an HDMI port so it’s not that old . My kids have no idea what an “old “ Tv really is . I had actually orders this to make my father in laws TV fun while we visit and it really made his old TV do everything our newer tv can . It’s very user friendly plug and play . I swear I needed this thing like 10 years ago . It’s a very well designed piece of electronics. Overall I’m impressed as are my kids and husband . My father in law thinks I’m brilliant! I didn’t tell him it’s not me , that it’s this little plug and play adapter . I think it’s worth the retail asking price and upgrades even the most basic tV . It’s idiot proof IMO . It has so many uses besides the basic charger function . Mom tested , kid approved . Buy it you’ll like it !! Good gift for any owner of the above mentioned devices .

title: This came with the charger plug in part !!
text: So Iv ordered a few of these and been disappointed by the photo in the listing showing a charging block that plugs into the outlet but it isn’t actually included in the set . This had it included !! I was so happy it was included and not just in the photo of the listing . I can’t even begin to describe how happy I am about this one little piece being included . It is such an important piece and needed to get the most out of the charging setup . It is really a complete set up . It’s great . Well made and really helping to keep the battery from dying . My son has a quest 2 and this worked flawlessly with it .

title: These are really nice
text: I had ordered the $20 set fir my son and he was trilled . These came up in my feed and after a little research I found out that the pro and quest 2 have the same handles so I ordered these for my son and he’s so happy . The other ones were exactly what $20 ones would be expected to be and these are double the cost but 3x better quality. It’s funny how when you have no upgrades that a simple upgrade seems amazing and then you get upgraded from that and it’s just mind blowing . It’s like they say , you get what you pay for . These are so well done!! Works on quest 2 perfectly

title: Affordable fix for a common issue
text: It’s an almost complete replacement kit , I’m a noob to this and had expected the replacement cases I saw in the listing but it’s everything but that . I know now that it’s just the insides and not the white case part for the bottom . I am new to this VR parts world and wanted to have everything needed for repairs because it is such a common issue I knew it was a matter of when not if it needed repair . I wish they would only feature the parts included in the photo of the item listing. I have been watching the tutorials in preparation of the day my son tells me he’s having controller issues. I think I’m ready.

title: Works great for the quest and PS5
text: I had ordered this for our quest 2 and used it for that until the usb c cable for the ps5 was chewed on amd the end chewed off . It plugs into the usb port on the back of ps5 and works to charge the Ps5 controller and is super long . It’s a nice length for the quest and makes it so much easier to move around. Overall I think it’s a good choice for a quest cable upgrade or ps5 extra long controller charging cable . I used it to charge a bunch of other usb C devices as well . Go pro compatible too. Sooooo many uses . I honestly think you can’t go wrong with this . It’s nice to have such a long cord . It’s a good gift too . I’d recommend getting it is you have a need for a a good uSB C cord .

title: The joy in my sons face said it all
text: I have these to him today and he immediately played beat saber . I could hear him thru my wall having a blast . After few hours he come back and I asked him what he would rate them and he said 5 stars . He said he had a good time scoring early with the baton separated and using them to have a longer reach . I told him I’d read that gorilla tag was supposed to be more fun with them and his eyes got big and he took off to go play his little heart out . It’s a cheap upgrade for the joy he gets from these .
